rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Captain Harry Stebbings
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Captain Harry Stebbings (United States, 1980).
Introduced in United States by Country Garden Nursery (USA) in 1980 as 'Captain Harry Stebbings'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-pink. Moderate, fruity fragrance. 35 to 50 petals. Large, very double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: For clarification about parentage, see References.
